items.question: Who runs this website?
items.answer: This website is run exclusively by PlaywithK. For more questions on this topic, check out the 'Web Development' tab.

items.question: What is the purpose of the website?
items.answer: PlaywithK.de is meant to inform about projects by and with PlaywithK, and to help discover new things!

items.question: Is this site private or commercial?
items.answer: This website is used exclusively for private purposes and has no commercial intent.

items.question: May I reuse content from the website?
items.answer: All content from PlaywithK.de may be freely reused with a link back to the website.

items.question: How often are contents updated?
items.answer: The website information may be outdated because it is created in my free time. The exact last edit date can be seen at the bottom of each page.
